response.sql: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM account_orders) AS difference_from_overall_average FROM account_orders), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(difference_from_overall_average) AS average_difference FROM differences GROUP BY region) SELECT d.account_id, d.region, d.order_count, d.difference_from_overall_average, d.difference_from_overall_average - r.average_difference AS excess_over_region_average FROM differences AS d JOIN region_averages AS r ON r.region = d.region WHERE d.difference_from_overall_average > r.average_difference ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC LIMIT 10;
